findings.pattern: Bots flagged weapon_gap hold mesos for an affordable, wearable weapon but have not bought it.
findings.evidence: Fish Spear lv20 is 20 to 22 levels below the bots. Zeco costs 225,000 mesos; they hold 4.77M, 8.25M and 3.21M. Options show 40.7 to 43.0 EXP/s with Zeco versus 24.4 now.
findings.proposed_check: For each bot with weapon_gap, if a buy option exists, price is under mesos and level is met, and the bot is not shopping, queue the purchase.

findings.pattern: Bandits are locked out of the best dagger by DEX and nothing in the stat plan fixes it.
findings.evidence: Gephart (attack 50, 375,000 mesos) needs DEX 70; the bots have 25 to 30 DEX. All five hold 1.7M to 3.3M mesos, wear lv12 to 15 daggers, and carry weapon_gap.
findings.proposed_check: If best affordable weapon it cannot wear is set and the stat gap exceeds 20, flag for an AP or weapon plan review.

findings.pattern: Bots sit on maps where the snapshot lists much higher EXP per second options.
findings.evidence: Current map EXP is 8.7 to 10.5 (Dark Stump, Cynical Orange Mushroom, Pig) versus options of 19 to 40.7 EXP/s with the same weapon.
findings.proposed_check: If the current map option EXP is under half the best option EXP and the bot is not on a drop quest target, recommend a move.
